messages:
deploy-bot: Alert: EU canary (region=eu) p95 latency 820ms (threshold 600ms). error-rate 5.2% on model-service v2.3. Suggested: PARTIAL_ROLLBACK -> v2.2.9 for eu unless overridden in 5m.
Maya: saw it. can someone check seq length distribution? maybe kv-cache regression.
Raj: traces show spikes aligned with long-context requests (~4096). kv cache miss rate up.
Tess: if kv-cache, limit impact to eu. rolling back whole release seems heavy.
Jim: agree limit to eu. do we have release notes for v2.3 mentioning kv prefetch change?
Olivia: drafting customer note for affected accounts now.
Maya: hold auto-rollback for 3m while we verify. if it's a config, toggle first.
deploy-bot: Holding auto-rollback. countdown 3m.
Raj: root cause: aggressive kv prefetch change in runtime introduced in v2.3. repro: `./run_infer --model v2.3 --seq 4096 --batch 4` -> p95 ~900ms.
Tess: can we flip the prefetch flag? `rwctl feature toggle runtime.kv_prefetch=false --env eu` Would be lower impact.
Maya: how long to toggle?
Raj: ~30s to propagate. need emergency config push approval.
Jim: prefer config toggle over rollback. lower blast radius.
Olivia: updating customer note: "Mitigating via config change, will follow up if rollback needed."
Support Bot: Created INC-2026; notifying on-call and top 5 customers in eu.
Maya: do the toggle; monitor 10m. if p95 > 650ms or errors > 2% then rollback to v2.2.9 eu-only. who runs rollback?
Tess: I will. rollback command: `rwctl release rollback --region eu --to-version 2.2.9 --scope canary,dedicated`
Raj: toggled runtime.kv_prefetch=false in eu. propagation: `applied on 12/12 nodes`.
deploy-bot: Re-eval: p95 now 480ms, error-rate 0.9% over 2m. condition cleared. Auto-rollback cancelled.
Maya: keep toggle, schedule hotfix PR for conservative prefetch and mark for 2.3.1.
Tess: PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/2345 assign Raj.
Olivia: customer emails sent to affected accounts with incident link and mitigation.
Support Bot: INC-2026 updated: RESOLVED (mitigated via config toggle).
Maya: please write a short blameless postmortem: timeline, decision tree, whether rollback would have been safer. Action items: add canary gating for kv_prefetch, add p95-by-seqlen alert, release notes checklist for infra changes.
Jim: I'll draft release-note addendum and rollback runbook (commands, contacts, comm templates).
Tess: closing thread. thanks all :thumbsup:
Olivia: thanks everyone, will follow up with customers in 24h.
